item.title: [−1] 10-year G-Sec yield climbs back to about 7.40% after the wholesale inflation jump
item.description:
Up from 7.36% on Tuesday, matching Monday's high. The yield was 7.19% before the RBI hike. Resuming its rise after a one-day pause.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs

Why it matters: Higher yields raise borrowing costs for government, companies and home buyers and cut the value of banks' bond holdings.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
